# Cook

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-5da4d8f9080248da"></a>

## Become a Cook

Zeff ate his own leg so a little boy could eat his share. Sanji has never let anyone go hungry since.

Choose Cook as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Cook

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Cook XP +300

<a id="q-16d9384fcd7cad0e"></a>

## Apprentice Cook

A ship's galley is the heart of the crew.

Reach Cook level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Cook](cook.md#q-5da4d8f9080248da)

**Tasks**

- Reach Cook level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Cook XP +800

<a id="q-4e389e99d95504c2"></a>

## Journeyman Cook

The Baratie serves anyone who pays and feeds anyone who cannot. Cook something superb in its honour.

Reach Cook level 25, Cook a dish of Superb quality, Prepare a Sashimi Assortment and land on a harbour town in East Blue.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Cook](cook.md#q-16d9384fcd7cad0e)

**Tasks**

- Reach Cook level 25
- Cook a dish of Superb quality
- Prepare a Sashimi Assortment
- Land on a harbour town in East Blue

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Cook XP +3,000

<a id="q-346f03f043b491ce"></a>

## Expert Cook

The Pirate's Lunch and the dishes of a Sea King are the last recipes of the islands.

Reach Cook level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Cook](cook.md#q-4e389e99d95504c2)

**Tasks**

- Reach Cook level 50
- Prepare a Pirate's Lunch
- Cook all three Sea King dishes

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Cook XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-13ac97f18f92b676"></a>

## Master Cook

The Baratie's head chef wears the hat. Take it.

Reach Cook level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Cook](cook.md#q-346f03f043b491ce)

**Tasks**

- Reach Cook level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
